question: A 62-year-old woman comes to the physician for evaluation of a mole on her forearm that has increased in size over the last several months. Physical examination shows a 9-mm skin lesion on the right forearm with irregular borders. An excisional biopsy is performed, and genetic analysis shows a mutation in the gene that encodes B-Raf. Which of the following cellular events most likely predisposed this patient to developing this skin lesion?

options.opc: Relocation of a chromosomal segment onto a nonhomologous chromosome
options.opd: Formation of covalent bonds between adjacent pyrimidine bases
options.ope: Deamination of cytosine, guanine, and adenine nucleotides
